provenance.source_title: How Did Ancient Humans Actually Survive Without Salt

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒把观众放进一个人人经历过的日常场景,零铺垫完成沉浸
examples.expression_mechanism: Imagine + You are at + 日常场景 的第二人称代入开场
examples.example_text: Imagine. You are at dinner. Someone made pasta.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句话日常场景完成沉浸开场,前提是该场景人人都有体感记忆
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景设定与菜品

examples.psychological_goal: 用群体表情特写把小事渲染成背叛,再用一句大白话揭底制造笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟人化夸张(食物背叛人)+ 极短真相句落差
examples.example_text: You look around, and everyone has the same face—the same grimace people make when food has deeply betrayed them. Someone forgot to add salt.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先夸张渲染情绪反应、再用朴素短句揭底的两拍幽默
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比喻与场景

examples.psychological_goal: 用急救级动作描写放大日常物品的必需性,为后文刚需论证埋伏笔
examples.expression_mechanism: as if + 紧急情境 的夸张类比
examples.example_text: People are reaching for the salt shaker as if it's an emergency
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用夸张类比把日常动作写成生死时刻,暗中服务论点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比;夸张须服务论点而非单纯搞笑

examples.psychological_goal: 把刚建立的体感记忆变成通往反事实世界的传送门
examples.expression_mechanism: "hold on to that feeling"体感定格 + 名词化重述
examples.example_text: Now hold on to that feeling, that instant internal relief from getting sodium when it was lacking in your diet
examples.usage_instruction: 学习场景完成后用一句话冻结感受再跳转时空
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用句式;被冻结的必须是观众刚亲历的感受

examples.psychological_goal: 主问题抛出后先转向底层机制,建立"先懂为什么再懂怎么办"的讲解顺序
examples.expression_mechanism: To understand X, we first need to understand Y 的降层转场
examples.example_text: To understand how ancient people lived without salt, we first need to understand why the body needs sodium so much in the first place.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用降层转场把大问题拆成可讲解的底层问题
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该主题;降层必须真的通向答案而非绕路

examples.psychological_goal: 用与氧气并列的定性把"必需"推到不可辩驳的级别
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定可选性 + 与最高级必需品类比 的两句定性
examples.example_text: The body does not consider sodium to be something optional. He treats sodium the same way he treats oxygen.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"身体把它当作X"句式为抽象营养素定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比对象;定性须有前文机制铺垫支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 全片中枢揭示:答案一直藏在食物本身
examples.expression_mechanism: 总起定性句 + 四连清单证据
examples.example_text: Natural animal foods are extremely rich in sodium. Fresh meat, organ tissues, blood, and bone marrow contain significant amounts of natural sodium.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"先给结论句、再给清单"的揭示结构
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该清单内容与结论措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 把"异常生理反应"重构为"按设计运行",翻转对身体的误解
examples.expression_mechanism: 功能重述 + 工程词汇(calibrated)短判决句
examples.example_text: They do exactly what they were created to do. They were calibrated for scarcity.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"校准/预设"类工程词汇为进化机制定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该判决句措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个意想不到的小动物细节坐实跨物种的共同驱动
examples.expression_mechanism: 具象微场景白描(昆虫+人体+目的)
examples.example_text: Butterflies land on sweaty human skin to collect sodium from sweat.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习挑选最小最意外的例证制造"连它都这样"的惊奇
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该例证;例证必须真实可查

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话把叙事从个人生理升级为文明史,明示风险量级跳档
examples.expression_mechanism: takes a decisive turn 转向宣告 + stakes 升级定性
examples.example_text: And now history takes a decisive turn, and the stakes suddenly become civilizational.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在中段用一句元叙述换挡句提升格局
examples.negative_instruction: 不要滥用换挡句;升级必须有后文史实兑现

examples.psychological_goal: 用意象句回答"缺口如何被填补",并以三连身份升格收尾
examples.expression_mechanism: 隐喻动词 + as a X 三连排比升格
examples.example_text: And salt poured into this abyss. As a commodity, as a technology, and ultimately as a form of power.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"意象回答+三连身份"把物质史写成权力史
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该意象与排比项

examples.psychological_goal: 问题提出后立即给答案,用"优雅"定性制造欣赏感
examples.expression_mechanism: here is an elegant solution 预告 + 一句白描答案
examples.example_text: But here is an elegant solution that ancient people came up with. They drank this decoction.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"预告-白描"两步,答案本身越朴素越好
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该解决方案内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用一组对比数字把"低摄入也能健康"从观点变成数据冲击
examples.expression_mechanism: 估计值 + compared to + 对照组数字 的数据并置
examples.example_text: Their estimated daily sodium intake was about 200 mg, compared to the 3,400 mg consumed by the average American.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习数字对比句的构造:先主体数据,再对照基准
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该数据;数据必须有可靠来源

examples.psychological_goal: 把远古史瞬间接到"你现在的身体",完成深度时间的个人化
examples.expression_mechanism: 同位语插入(your body right now)+ 深度时间数字
examples.example_text: The human body, your body right now, was shaped and honed during those 290,000 pre-agrarian years.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同位语把宏大时间尺度拽回观众身体
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该数字与时间框架

examples.psychological_goal: 点破古今同一机制被现代环境反转,制造不安的顿悟
examples.expression_mechanism: 极短等同句 + Only 转折 + 程度副词砸尾
examples.example_text: The mechanism is identical. Only the context has changed—and catastrophically.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"机制相同、情境剧变"的失配揭示句式
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式措辞;程度副词必须有事实支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 显式回答标题主问题,并顺手刺一下现代饮食
examples.expression_mechanism: They survived because 直接回答 + 对照性同位语补刀
examples.example_text: They survived because the food they ate was naturally high in sodium, something you can almost never say about modern processed foods.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习主问题回收时先给一句干净答案,再附一句对照评论
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该答案内容;补刀不能喧宾夺主

examples.psychological_goal: 用祖先视角倒置现代困境,制造荒诞又心酸的情感冲击
examples.expression_mechanism: 反事实情感投射 + 一生行为的极简对照
examples.example_text: Your ancestors would have been appalled at the thought of too much salt. They spent their whole lives trying to find just a little bit.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"古人若看到会怎样"的视角倒置收尾情感线
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该投射内容;倒置须紧扣全片主题

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众此刻的日常动作定义为漫长历史的终点,完成意义放大
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常动作白描 + final point of + 时间尺度 的意义赋值
examples.example_text: This effortless reflexive gesture represents the final point of 300,000 years of history.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾把镜头拉回观众手边的动作并赋予历史重量
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该动作与数字

examples.psychological_goal: 用格言句收束全片,把具体史实升华为普世判断
examples.expression_mechanism: 让步转折开头 + 格言式普世判断
examples.example_text: But, in the end, almost everything worth having comes at a price.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾格言要超出本片主题一寸,给观众一句能带走的话
